shortDescription: BALLERUP, Denmark, Sept. 01, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- LiqTech International, Inc. children: , a clean technology company specializing in advanced ceramic filtration solutions, today announced that its Aquatics business, which includes the Company’s commercial swimming pool solutions, has expanded its partnership agreement with Pool4You, a leading Finnish specialist in swimming pool water treatment.

The expanded agreement supports LiqTech’s continued geographic expansion within Aquatics and strengthens the Company’s ability to serve public, municipal, and institutional aquatic facilities in Finland through an established local partner with extensive market reach and technical expertise.

Pool4You has more than 40 years of experience in pool water treatment and is one of Finland’s most established operators in the sector, with 45 pool industry professionals and offices in four locations. The company has implemented more than 80 percent of the water treatment systems in Finnish public swimming pools and serves more than 5,000 customers annually.

The expanded partnership strengthens LiqTech’s access to the Finnish market through Pool4You’s established customer relationships, project experience, and service organization. Together, the companies will support public, municipal, and institutional aquatic facilities seeking modern, reliable, and space-efficient water treatment solutions.

“We are pleased to expand our partnership with Pool4You as we continue to build momentum in our Aquatics business,” said Fei Chen, CEO of LiqTech. “Pool4You brings strong local expertise, customer relationships, and project execution capabilities in Finland. This expanded partnership supports our strategy to grow QlariFlow™ through strong regional partners and increase adoption of ceramic membrane filtration in commercial pool applications.”

With the expanded agreement, LiqTech continues to execute on its Aquatics growth strategy by strengthening regional partnerships, increasing market access, and positioning QlariFlow™ as a compelling alternative to traditional filtration technologies for public and commercial swimming pool applications.

LiqTech International, Inc. is a clean technology company that manufactures and markets highly specialized filtration products and systems for liquid and gas applications. Founded in 2000, LiqTech’s patented silicon carbide (SiC) technology is designed to address demanding filtration challenges across industrial water, oil & gas, marine, emissions control, and Aquatics, including commercial swimming pool applications.
Through its advanced membrane and filtration technologies, LiqTech helps customers improve water quality, enable water reuse, reduce emissions, and support more efficient and sustainable operations.
